exemptions.ruling: Owner ruling 2026-11-12 — §5.5 EXCEPTION to the Icongate law: the §5.5 product-logo system is exempt from the in-icon wordmark requirement; sweeps classify the set EXEMPT-BY-RULING, not FAIL. The strict rule stands for standalone product icons.
exemptions.set: §5.5 product-logo system — the monogram marks (generator: branding/generate_product_logos.py)

note: Owner rulings that exempt named sets from the in-icon wordmark requirement. A sweep classifies files under an exempt set as EXEMPT — a distinct verdict class, never a PASS and never a FAIL — with the ruling cited on the row. Exemptions apply to `sweep` only: `check` always gates a single icon on the strict rule.
